output_budget.note: The one-shot Global plan is capped at 4,096 visible tokens for every model. Report the executed settings, not a single uniform budget.

local-view-20260824.purpose: Local View (incremental workflow construction) ablation: the model builds one WorkflowPlan through the append-only plan editor — one editor-operation JSON per turn, immutable accepted prefix, planning only — and the frozen plan is executed on every hidden variant exactly like Global View. Roster = every model configuration that ran replan, so the four settings (global/local/react/replan) share one model set. Measures incremental plan construction as an orthogonal capability axis; results.csv mode 'local' and tier layout <tier>/<model>/local.
